defaults.prerequisites: Create valid Runs and Work Packets in real temporary projects on a supported local filesystem.
defaults.action: Exercise create_run and submit_candidate through the core dispatcher with deterministic publication controls and real subprocesses.

rows.requirement: Issue #155: inject deterministic clock, entropy, and faults at every Run and StepArtifact publication boundary
rows.oracle: Every pre-commit fault returns io/io_error without an authoritative record; every post-commit fault leaves one complete inspectable record.

rows.requirement: Issue #155: survive process termination before and after logical commit
rows.oracle: Killing a real core subprocess before commit exposes no Run or attempt; killing it after commit exposes one complete authoritative record.

rows.requirement: Issue #155: serialize every mutation with one exclusive per-Run writer lock and re-inspection
rows.oracle: Run creation and submission hold the fixed per-Run lock through publication, and submission re-inspects eligibility before allocating an attempt.

rows.requirement: Issue #155: fail lock contention immediately without stealing
rows.oracle: A simultaneous contender receives conflict/run_locked while the observed opaque lock remains unchanged.

rows.requirement: Issue #155: elect one winner in at least 100 seeded same-opportunity races
rows.oracle: Each retained seed yields exactly one attempt-1 winner, one settled conflict, contiguous history, and no overwritten Result.

rows.requirement: Issue #155: preserve independent eligible submissions in at least 100 seeded races
rows.oracle: Each retained seed safely retries only explicit run_locked contention and finishes with one attempt-1 Result for each independent node.

rows.requirement: Issue #155: make a lost submission response safe to inspect without replay
rows.oracle: After process termination, inspect_run distinguishes an uncommitted attempt from the exact committed attempt and Result.

rows.requirement: Issue #155: retain race seeds and diagnostic facts on failure
rows.oracle: Every race assertion reports its seed and the structured success or failure facts from both contenders.
